name: Akshay Pillai
player_statement:
A complete player, Akshay Pillai has made a big mark in cricket. With 137 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 34, with an average of 8.74 and a quick strike rate of 88.90. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 7 sixes and 105 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 21.1 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 9.07. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
